entries.cadb658f8dce1542: R&D is carried out by the Technology Headquarters and subsidiary Asahi FR Research Institute, and the company has built a track record of adoptions of products that make use of its proprietary technology, such as ASA COLOR LENS, which applies optical design technology to silicone material technology and has been adopted by the International Space Station. In the sports field, orders for table tennis racket rubber continued to increase, and revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 reached a record high.
entries.ceb905f59b1396ce: This business manufactures and sells medical rubber products and sanitary rubber products with excellent hygiene and shock absorption. The company manufactures them, and the company and its subsidiary Asahi Frontmedic Co., Ltd. sell them in Japan and other Asian countries. The main products are rubber stoppers for blood collection and for mixing injection solutions in diagnosis and treatment, medical check valves, prefilled syringe gaskets and procedure simulator products. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥1,905 million, the highest sales on record. The main production base is the Dai-ni Fukushima Plant.

entries.e75e78948ef66968: Aiming to realize “AR-2030 VISION” looking toward 2030, it has formulated its 15th Medium-Term Management Plan covering the period from April 2026 to March 2031, under the theme “Beyond 2030,” with a basic policy of “aiming for sustainable growth through wellness branding.” It says it will focus on areas centered on “wellness” in the mobility (automotive), medical, sports and health, and lifestyle markets, and will pursue strengthening its proposal capabilities from OEM to ODM, integrating technologies and know-how across businesses, and building business models through alliances with outside partners.
